titre: Nouveaux cas de cancer projetés aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Millions de nouveaux cas projetés par an, 2023 à 2026

2023.texte: in 2023 there are projected to be 1,958,310 new cancer cases and 609,820 cancer deaths in the United States

2024.texte: the projected number of new diagnoses now tops 2 million (2,001,140) for the first time

2025.texte: In 2025, 2,041,910 new cancer cases and 618,120 cancer deaths are projected to occur in the United States.

2026.texte: In 2026 in the U.S., approximately 2,114,850 new cancer diagnoses (5,800 each day) are projected to occur
